# Monocypher 4.0.3

Unmodified files from https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher/tree/4.0.3:
`src/monocypher.c`, `src/monocypher.h`, `src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.c`,
`src/optional/monocypher-ed25519.h`, and `LICENCE.md`. The update builds use
Ed25519 to verify the signed manifest and SHA-512 to verify the payload.
The upstream notice and dual license are provided in LICENCE.md.
